How to Reach Us

The best way to contact jailinmate.net is by email at contact@jailinmate.net. We monitor this inbox daily and respond to all inquiries within 48 hours on business days (Monday–Friday).

Please include as much detail as possible in your message so we can help you quickly — county name, state, and a description of the issue or question.

What We Can Help With

  • Broken or outdated links — If a link to a county jail or sheriff search tool is no longer working, let us know and we'll update it within 24 hours.
  • Incorrect county information — If we have the wrong phone number, address, or URL for a county facility, please report it.
  • Missing counties — If your county is not listed, we can add it. Email us the county name, state, and the official government search URL.
  • General questions — Questions about how to use the site, how inmate lookup works, or how to contact a facility.
  • Privacy and data questions — Questions about our Privacy Policy or your data rights.
  • Press and media inquiries — Media questions about the site or public records accessibility.

Data Removal and Correction Requests

jailinmate.net does not host inmate records. We only link to official government websites operated by county sheriff offices and departments of corrections.

To request removal from official government records (expungement, sealing, or correction of a booking record), you must contact the government agency that maintains the record directly. We can provide you with the contact information for the relevant county facility — just email us the county and state.

To report inaccurate or outdated information on jailinmate.net (such as an incorrect link, wrong facility name, or wrong phone number), email contact@jailinmate.net with:

  • The county and state
  • What information is incorrect
  • What the correct information should be (if known)

We will review and update the page within 24–48 hours.

What We Cannot Help With

Please note that there are some things outside our control:

  • We cannot look up specific inmates — use the county search tools linked from our county pages
  • We cannot provide legal advice about arrests, charges, or bail
  • We cannot force a government agency to remove or change their records
  • We cannot restore a link if the government agency has taken down their search tool

For legal matters, please consult a licensed attorney. For questions about bail, contact a licensed bail bondsman in the relevant county.

Response Times

  • General questions and link reports: within 48 hours
  • Broken link fixes: within 24 hours after confirmation
  • Privacy and data requests: within 48 hours (CCPA: 45 days, GDPR: 30 days)
  • Media inquiries: within 48 hours
